$comment: Single source for every local development and test port (ADR-0023). Each work folder bugaboo.winN has a block of `stride` ports, block N starting at first + (N - 1) * stride, so several folders can build and test at the same time. Any other folder (CI, a fresh clone) uses block 1; BUGABOO_PORT_BLOCK names another block. The numbers below are offsets inside a block. The whole range 47200-48099 is free on the main dev PC and below Windows' dynamic range (49152 and up). Tools use strictPort and fail loudly if a port is busy. Change ports only here.
